title: S-adenosylmethionine Synthesis and Stress Granule Assembly in Yeast Cultures
summary: This cluster revolves around the synthesis of S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) and its involvement in methionine metabolism. SAM is synthesized by Sam1 and Sam2 genes, which are expressed in yeast cultures. The stress granules, which are involved in Ded1, are assembled by Sam1. The stress granules accumulate in foci, which are affected by 2-deoxyglucose and cycloheximide. The glucose and YPD affect Sam1, which colocalizes with Sam2. The sequencing and Invitrogen are involved in the process, with Thermo Fisher Scientific and Agilent Technologies performing the sequencing. The cancer is affected by methionine metabolism, which is involved in Liver Health.
